headline: Crimson Tide Pods: Preseason Front Office Brief
executive_summary: Crimson Tide Pods is projected #14 of 16 with a 533.60 projected-starting-lineup C-AVI total, led by DeVonta Smith, Alec Pierce, and Justin Herbert. The immediate priority is improving the RB slot without weakening that core.
